rows.text: A monstrous legion created from Asat Pramad's split "Voracity" power, now the prototype of the "imagenae." Asat Pramad sensed within the dormant core from Ahatopia an unending hunger tied to the Voracity, whose pulsation resonated closely with the Path of Destruction. Amused by this restless force, he began his dark creation: erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring mouths that howl, demand, and consume without end.
